sections.title: Computation of the Child’s Age
sections.hint: After verifying the dates, compute the child’s age by subtracting the date he was born from the date the test was administered. Each month is composed of 30 days. Do not round off the months or years.Write the examiner’s name each time the test is administered.

children.title: Climbs on chair or other elevated piece of furniture like a bed without help
children.hint: Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Walks backwards
children.hint:
MATERIAL: toy
PROCEDURE:Ask the child to walk backwards by demonstrating this. Credit if the child is able to walk backwards without falling and holding on to anything. Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Runs without tripping or falling
children.hint:
MATERIAL: ball
PROCEDURE:Encourage the child to run by rolling a ball across the floor.Credit if the child can run fast and smoothly without tripping or falling.

children.title: Walks down stairs, two feet on each step, with one hand held
children.hint: Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Walks upstairs holding onto a handrail, two feet on each step
children.hint:
MATERIAL: toy
PROCEDURE:Place a toy in the middle of the step and ask the child to walk up the stairs to get the toy.Credit if the child walks up the stairs using the handrail or wall for support and places both feet on each step before stepping on the next one. Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Walks upstairs with alternate feet without holding onto a handrail
children.hint:
MATERIAL: toy
PROCEDURE:Place a toy in the middle of the step and ask the child to walk upstairs to get the toy.Credit if the child walks upstairs, alternating his feet as he steps on each successive step without holding on to the handrail or wall for support. Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Walks downstairs with alternate feet without holding onto a handrail
children.hint:
MATERIAL: toy
PROCEDURE:Place a toy in the middle of the step and ask the child to walk downstairs to get the toy.Credit if the child walks down- stairs, alternating his feet as he steps on each successive step without holding onto the handrail or wall for support. Do not give credit if the child places both feet on the step or uses the handrail or wall for support. Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Moves body part as directed
children.hint: PROCEDURE: Ask the child to raise both arms.

children.title: Jumps up
children.hint: This must be elicited by the interviewer.

children.title: Uses all five fingers to get food/toys placed on a flat surface
children.hint:
MATERIAL: small toy /object
PROCEDURE:Seat the child on the parent’s lap with his elbows at level with the tabletop and his hands on the table or flat surface. Drop a small toy in front of him and attract his attention by pointing to the toy or tapping the table/flat surface. Credit if the child picks up the toy, using all five fingers as if raking.

children.title: Picks up objects with thumb and index finger
children.hint:
MATERIAL: any small toy or food
PROCEDURE:Place a toy/food in front of the child and within his reach. Attract his attention by tapping near the toy/food.Credit if the child uses the tips of his thumb and index or forefinger to pick up the toy/food.

children.title: Displays a definite hand preference
children.hint:
MATERIAL: toy
PROCEDURE:Place the toy directly in front of the child at midline (not to his left or his right) and ask him to reach for this.Credit if he uses the same hand two out of three times. Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Displays a definite hand preference
children.hint:
MATERIAL: toy
PROCEDURE:Place the toy directly in front of the child at midline (not to his left or his right) and ask him to reach for this.Credit if he uses the same hand two out of three times. Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Feeds self using fingers to eat rice/viands with spillage
children.hint: Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Participates when being dressed (e.g., raises arms or lifts leg)
children.hint: Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Pulls down gartered short pants
children.hint: Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Informs the adult only after he has already urinated (peed) or moved his bowels (poohed) in his underpants
children.hint: Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Informs the adult of need to urinate (pee) or move bowels (pooh-pooh) so he can be brought to a designated place (e.g., comfort room)
children.hint: Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Participates when bathing (e.g., rubbing arms with soap)
children.hint: Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Washes and dries hands without any help
children.hint: Ask the caregiver if the child can wash and dry his hands without any help or supervision except to turn on/off faucets that are out of reach.

children.title: Points to a family member when asked to do so
children.hint: PROCEDURE: Ask the child to point to his mother/caregiver. Credit if he does so.

children.title: Points to five body parts on himself when asked to do so
children.hint: PROCEDURE: Have the child point to his eyes, nose, mouth, hands and feet or other body part. Credit if he can point to all these.

children.title: Uses five to 20 recognizable words
children.hint: PROCEDURE: Ask the caregiver if the child can clearly say five to six words aside from mama and papa. This will be the minimum number.

children.title: Uses pronouns (e.g. I, me, ako, akin)
children.hint: Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Looks in the direction of fallen object
children.hint:
MATERIAL: spoon/ball
PROCEDURE: With the child seated, get his attention and drop a spoon/ ball in front of him. Then observe if his eyes look down as it falls. Credit if the child can bring his eyes and head down as the object falls.

children.title: Looks for a partially hidden object
children.hint:
MATERIAL: ball, small towel/cloth
PROCEDURE: With the child facing you, partially hide a ball behind a small towel and observe if he will look for it and find it. Credit if the child pulls the towel and gets the hidden ball.

children.title: Enjoys watching activities of nearby people or animals
children.hint: Parental report will suffice.

children.title: Friendly with strangers but initially may show slight anxiety or shyness
children.hint: Parental report will suffice.

children.hint: For example, Health of family members/family problems/ economic conditions/etc.

children.hint: For example, Facilities/type of house/ household items/interaction/etc.

sections.title: Domain Scoring
sections.hint: Transfer the raw score for each domain in the table below. Using the Scaled Score Equivalent of Raw Scores Table, convert the raw scores to Scaled Scores appropriate to the age of the child. To arrive at the Sum of Scaled Scores, add the Scaled Scores across all domains. To derive the Standard Score, refer to the Standard Score Equivalent of Sums of Scaled Scores Table. Write the Child’s age on each evaluation.
